summary: Iteration 70 - Offline PDF Guide Feature Testing Complete. Fixed critical bug in PDF endpoint (was checking 'ambassador_level' instead of 'level'). All backend API tests passed (7/7). All frontend UI tests passed. The OfflineGuideDownload component is properly gated inside PremiumGate for ambassadors only.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/ai/travel-plan/pdf returns 200 with valid PDF for admin/ambassador
Backend: Content-Disposition header has correct filename (guia-{destination}-4luis.pdf)
Backend: PDF endpoint respects 'sections' parameter (can exclude sections)
Backend: PDF endpoint includes static map when geocode_data is provided
Backend: POST /api/ai/travel-plan/pdf returns 400 when plan is missing
Backend: POST /api/ai/travel-plan/pdf returns 403 for non-ambassador user
Frontend: data-testid='offline-guide' component exists when ambassador views generated plan
Frontend: data-testid='download-pdf-btn' button exists with text 'Descarregar guia offline'
Frontend: data-testid='customize-sections-toggle' toggle for section customization exists
Frontend: OfflineGuideDownload is inside PremiumGate (verified in TravelPlanner.js lines 1076-1078)

bugs_fixed.issue: PDF endpoint was checking 'ambassador_level' field but user model uses 'level' field
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed from user_doc.get('ambassador_level') to user_doc.get('level') and updated condition to check level != 'embaixador'

critical_code_review_comments: PDF generation uses ReportLab library with proper 4Luis branding (PEACH color #FFBE98)
Static map generation uses staticmap library with CartoDB tiles
All 6 sections are customizable: flights, hotel, map, itinerary, tips, transport
PremiumGate component properly blurs content and shows lock icon for non-ambassadors
OfflineGuideDownload component has all required data-testid attributes for testing
geocodeData state is properly passed from TravelPlanner to OfflineGuideDownload
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (fixed ambassador level check in PDF endpoint)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 70 verified Offline PDF Guide feature. Key findings: (1) PDF endpoint at POST /api/ai/travel-plan/pdf generates valid PDF with 4Luis branding. (2) PDF is ambassador-only (returns 403 for sonhador level users). (3) Sections can be customized via 'sections' parameter. (4) Static map is included when geocode_data is provided. (5) OfflineGuideDownload component is inside PremiumGate in TravelPlanner.js. (6) All 6 section toggles have data-testid attributes. (7) Fixed bug: endpoint was checking wrong field 'ambassador_level' instead of 'level'.
